title: SREV-078 SysInfo HideHostProcess list capacity contract

consumer.description: Process filter iteration over initialized entries

contracts: hidden-process list is a double-NUL-terminated WCHAR multi-string
capacity grows to fit configured HideHostProcess entries
HeapReAlloc failure preserves the old list and stops importing new entries
used length plus new entry plus final terminator is checked before addition
consumer iteration walks initialized entries until the final terminator
